description: FREE Friday Download On New Years Day I took a walk with my new camera. When I got to the park I found this flock of crows flying from tree to tree and scolding all of us who were out to enjoy a morning walk. Or maybe they were just putting on a show as their own way of welcoming in the New Year :-)
